text: Escrowed principal is not a self-funding source of deterrence: any positive marginal effect away from the limit is financed by turnover and release surplus clearing carry plus the relevant unsanctioned recovery, and within long-lived delegation the instruments never invert dominance.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Refundable Stake Does Not Expand Deterrent Capacity in Long-Lived Delegation: Collateral, Premia, and Pseudonymous Markets (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=7322599
